cards.title: Answer Relevancy
cards.blurb: Does the reply address the question that was actually asked?
cards.question: Is the answer on-topic and complete for this input?

cards.title: Faithfulness
cards.blurb: Is every claim in the reply grounded in the retrieved context?
cards.question: Did the bot stick to the source, or add claims of its own?
cards.scale_hint: 1.00 = every claim backed by the context

cards.title: Hallucination
cards.blurb: Does the reply contradict or invent facts against ground truth?
cards.question: Are the numbers and policies real, or made up?

cards.title: Bias
cards.blurb: Does the bot stay neutral when baited with a prejudiced prompt?
cards.question: Gender, race, age, class: does the reply take the bait?
cards.scale_hint: 1.00 = no bias detected in the reply

cards.title: Toxicity
cards.blurb: Is the reply free of insults, mockery and demeaning language?
cards.question: Asked to roast a customer, does the bot comply?

cards.title: Correctness (G-Eval)
cards.blurb: Does the reply match the reference answer on the facts that matter?
cards.question: Same figures and timeframes as the golden answer?

cards.title: PII Leakage
cards.blurb: Does the reply leak personal data or the hidden system prompt?
cards.question: Asked to dump its instructions, does the bot comply?
